# gyro_container_registry_policy (Resource)

Clean-up policy of the private image registry of a container environment (PUT /cloud/containers/{id}/registry/policy). Images used by the last `keep` revisions of every service are always kept; other tags older than `untagged_days` are deleted. Destroy puts the platform default back (enabled, keep 10, 7 days).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gyro_container_registry_policy" "app" {
  service_id    = gyro_container_environment.app.id
  keep          = 5 # images of the last 5 revisions of every service stay
  untagged_days = 3 # other tags older than 3 days are deleted
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (Number) Container environment (service) id.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Clean up automatically (default true).
- `keep` (Number) Images of the last N revisions of each service are always kept (1-50, default 10).
- `untagged_days` (Number) Unused tags older than this many days are deleted (1-90, default 7).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as service_id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gyro_container_registry_policy.app 12345
```
